description: This file defines classes and interfaces for handling notifications within an Android app, including the interaction with device notification listener service, processing notification-related actions, and generating JSON responses.

classes.name: NotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading notification snapshot, requesting rebind, and executing actions.

classes.name: SystemNotificationsStateProvider
classes.description: Singleton object implementing NotificationStateProvider, interacts with device notification listener service.

classes.name: NotificationsHandler
classes.description: Main class managing notification handling, including processing notification list and action requests, and generating JSON responses.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current notification snapshot using the state provider.

methods.name: requestServiceRebind
methods.description: Requests rebind of the notification listener service.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Executes a notification action (open, dismiss, reply).

methods.name: handleNotificationsList
methods.description: Handles request to list notifications and returns a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleNotificationsActions
methods.description: Handles notification actions based on JSON input and returns result JSON.

methods.name: readSnapshotWithRebind
methods.description: Reads notification snapshot and requests rebind if disconnected.

methods.name: snapshotPayloadJson
methods.description: Creates JSON string payload from a DeviceNotificationSnapshot.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses input JSON string into a JsonObject.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string value from JsonObject given a key.
